title: Trained Teacher Counsellors Employed in Schools
what_it_is: Trained Teacher Counsellors Employed in Schools

sections.label: School counsellors and teacher counsellors
sections.summary: Schools have one to two counsellors, and about 800 trained teacher counsellors with reduced teaching load supplement counselling support.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Every school has one to two school counsellors, who can be augmented by flexi-adjunct school counsellors, depending on the needs of the school.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Teacher counsellors supplement counselling support in schools by taking on a few less complex cases or support programmes that promote student well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There are close to 800 teacher counsellors deployed in our schools today.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Teacher counsellors undergo relevant training to better support their students, such as a part-time Certificate in School Counselling course and other short courses, such as a one-day course on Psychological First Aid.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: To manage their workload, teacher counsellors have reduced teaching load or are offloaded from other school duties.

sections.label: Teacher counsellors across schools
sections.summary: About 800 teacher counsellors are spread out to all schools.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: As I have mentioned earlier, there are about 800 teacher counsellors who are spread out to all our schools.

sections.label: Teacher Work Management Framework
sections.summary: The framework guides schools in managing teachers' workload and well-being, including off-loading teacher counsellors based on counselling time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: For instance, the Teacher Work Management Framework guides schools in managing teachers' workload and ensuring that teachers' well-being are taken care of.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: This includes recommending off-loading practices for teacher counsellors where, depending on the amount of time that they spend a week on their counselling duties, their workload is correspondingly reduced.

sections.label: Monitoring teacher counsellor training and deployment
sections.summary: Factors like subject, marking load and class profiles are considered, and school staff developers monitor teacher counsellors' training and deployment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: This takes into consideration factors, such as the nature of the subject that they teach, the frequency and intensity of the teacher counsellors' marking load, including class sizes, level, streams assigned and/or student profiles.

So, every school has got its school staff developer, and this school staff developer or designated key personnel would monitor and track the training and deployment of teacher counsellors in the school.
